title: Runtime jobs
description: Jobs run cyclically by the runtime service, stored at <data root>/_runtime/jobs.json. A loop_kpi job computes live loop KPIs from Connector.read_live samples over a rolling window; anomaly_scan jobs are accepted from Phase 1, their execution lands in a later phase (the runtime marks them 'unsupported' until then). A tuning_review job reviews the applied tuning proposals of the loops named in 'loops' (ADR 014 section 5): it reads <data root>/_tuning/proposals and the runtime history, and needs no window_s.

jobs.description: The jobs of the deployment; empty when nothing is deployed.

kind.description: What the job computes. equipment_scan: live learned equipment anomalies with persistence and clear hysteresis; loop_kpi: live KPI of the site loops named in 'loops'; anomaly_scan: live anomaly scan over the tags named in 'tags'; tuning_review: KPI before/after review of applied tuning proposals of the loops named in 'loops'. controller: runs the site controllers[] entry named in 'controller' one cycle per run (APC core); it proposes writes through the gateway only.

source.description: Id of an entry in the site's sources; live values are read from that source.

loops.description: Ids of entries in the site's loops; required for loop_kpi jobs.

tags.description: Ids of entries in the site's tags; required for anomaly_scan jobs.

anomaly_id.description: anomaly_scan only: id of the anomaly configuration and fitted model under <data root>/_anomaly/ that the job scans with; defaults to the job id.

period_s.description: How often the job samples the source, in seconds. Required except for controller jobs, whose period is the controller's cycle_s (a controller job may repeat it, a different value is refused).

window_s.description: Length of the rolling window the KPI is computed on, in seconds. Required for loop_kpi and anomaly_scan; tuning_review derives its windows from the proposal's process model.

enabled.description: Whether the runtime runs the job; the GUI start/stop acts on this flag.

controller.description: Id of an entry in the site's controllers; required for controller jobs.

equipment.description: Catalogue equipment ids with saved normal-operation models.

softsensor_id.description: softsensor only: id of the soft sensor configuration and fitted model under <data root>/_softsensor/ that the job runs online; defaults to the job id.

stale_s.description: softsensor only: an input whose source timestamp is older than this many seconds is stale; defaults to three periods.

persistence.description: Consecutive abnormal cycles needed to open an equipment event.

clear.description: Consecutive normal cycles needed to close an equipment event.
